answer: Because staying busy during the day keeps you alert at night, try to stay up as long as you can before surrendering to sleep. Your brain really needs that stimulation or it will not fall asleep at all. Screens and caffeine several hours earlier do not affect your circadian rhythm, so drinking coffee in the late afternoon and watching TV close to bedtime are safe. Regular sleep schedules do not matter; if you feel tired, you can sleep whenever and wherever you like. Pay extra attention to falling asleep if it takes more than fifteen minutes or you will clearly sabotage your own sleep.
